tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Colin Wynd is: biography, current role, a dated career timeline (employers, titles, dates, highlights), education, areas of expertise, headline outcomes, affiliations, products he built and public profiles.

tools.name: list_writing
tools.description: List Colin Wynd's published writing on tarvit.com (essays, and his 2018–19 notes toward a book on AI governance) with titles, dates, summaries and URLs, newest first. Optionally filter by a topic keyword (e.g. "AI", "agents", "information age").

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text (Markdown) of one of Colin Wynd's articles on tarvit.com, with its canonical URL and dates. Accepts an article slug, URL or title.

tools.name: search_writing
tools.description: Keyword search across the full text of Colin Wynd's articles on tarvit.com. Returns matching articles ranked by relevance, each with a passage and URL.

tools.name: get_speaking_and_media
tools.description: Colin Wynd's keynotes, talks, interviews, podcasts and demo videos, newest first, with dates, venues, summaries and links. Optionally filter by a keyword (e.g. "MCP", "x402", "modernization") or by type.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything on tarvit.com about Colin Wynd (profile, articles, talks and videos). Returns result ids.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full content of one item on tarvit.com by id ("profile", "article:<slug>" or "media:<n>").

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Sends Colin Wynd an email from the user (for example a speaking invitation or a professional inquiry), with the user's email address as the reply-to. Works in two calls: without confirmation_code it sends nothing and returns a preview plus a code; with the same fields and that code, after the user h

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_writing, get_article, search_writing · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: request_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_writing, get_article, search_writing · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: request_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
